name: Namakkal City Municipal Corporation
description: G.O. Ms. No. 105 constituted the corporation with effect from 12 August 2024. The order included the former Namakkal Municipality and the entire areas of 12 village panchayats: Vagurampatti, Vallipuram, Reddippatti, Veesanam, Marurpatti, Pappinaickenpatti, Siluvampatti, Thottipatti, Vasanthapuram, Vettampatti, Lathuvadi and Kadappalli.
